verdict.rationale: Airbyte's connector catalog (600+ sources/destinations spanning warehouses, lakes, databases) plus destination-agnostic core concepts (sync modes, typing-and-deduping one-to-one table mapping, schema change handling) mean the same pipeline/connection abstraction works across Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, object storage, etc. without redefining ETL logic. Missing for 10: explicit named connector docs for Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks in the evidence pack, and independent hands-on confirmation of switching destinations without pipeline changes.
